description: This file defines the 'Observation' class used for monitoring metrics on Spark DataFrames during actions. It includes methods for attaching observations to DataFrames and retrieving metrics after execution, along with related imports and test code.

classes.name: Observation
classes.description: A class to observe (named) metrics on a Spark DataFrame during actions, allowing collection and retrieval of metrics post-execution.

methods.name: __new__
methods.description: Creates a new Observation instance, possibly returning a connect.observation if running remotely.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes an Observation with an optional name, validating the input.

methods.name: _on
methods.description: Attaches the Observation to a DataFrame to observe specified aggregation expressions.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the observed metrics after the first action completes, blocking until available.
